The window frames in the background show slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines compared to the rigid geometry of the speakers.
The boundary between the bottom of the speaker cabinets and the cable mess is blurred. Some cables appear to emerge from inside the solid speaker casing rather than being plugged into ports.
